name: Add Issues to Sprint
description: Moves one or more issues into a sprint. Use to add issues to a sprint. Requires a sprint id (see the List Jira Sprints skill).
author: anything-jira

input.hint: Base URL of your Jira Server / Data Center instance.
Jira Data Center Personal Access Token. Sent as a Bearer token. Stored locally in this skill's plugin.json.

issueKeys.description: Comma-separated issue keys to move into the sprint, e.g. 'ENG-1,ENG-2'. Required.
